verdict.rationale: BVNK documents creating crypto and fiat wallets via API, including per-customer wallets by passing a customer ID and reference. Deposit addresses come either as reusable channel addresses or as unique per-payment blockchain addresses, which covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: documented key custody semantics (who holds the keys, custodial model), explicit per-purpose wallet patterns, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
